note: Single style bible for every generated illustration. Style defined 2026-10-08 from three owner samples (assets/art/style/), classic black-and-white fantasy RPG interior art and Dark Souls' 'withered beauty'. Changing this file changes every prompt hash.
style: Original black-and-white pen-and-ink illustration for HERALDRY SKIRMISH: THE DYING LANDS, a grim medieval dark-fantasy tabletop rulebook. Every image is drawn by the same single illustrator with one technique: traditional dip pen and fine liner on bright white paper, in the manner of a classic black-and-white fantasy roleplaying-game interior illustration. LINE: a confident, slightly heavier outer contour around each main form; thinner interior lines; line weight thins with distance. TONE: built only from ink marks - parallel hatching that follows the form, crosshatching for deep shade, sparse stippling for grit, ash and dust - plus a few deliberate solid-black shapes (eye sockets, open mouths, doorways, cast shadows, the darkest folds). No grey wash, no gradients, no smudging. LIGHT: one cold overcast light from the upper left; shadows fall lower right. SPACE: generous untouched white paper; skies are white or lightly ruled with sparse horizontal strokes; distance and fog are shown by sparser, finer lines. MOOD: withered beauty and faded grandeur - once-fine armour, cloth, stone and banners now rusted, cracked, tattered, overgrown or hollowed by age; ruined gothic and Romanesque masonry at a scale that dwarfs the living; quiet dread rather than gore. CRAFT: believable anatomy, armour construction, weapon grips, timber framing and masonry coursing; a single readable silhouette that still reads when printed two inches wide; serious, grounded proportions, never cute or cartoonish.
exclusions: No lettering, captions, labels, numbers, runes that look like text, signature, logo, watermark, border, frame, panel box, colour, sepia, grey wash, airbrush or digital gradient, glow effects, photorealism, 3D render, anime, manga, cartoon or chibi proportions, comic-book speed lines, tiled pattern, faint grid, parchment or paper texture, torn-paper edges. Do not imitate any named artist, game or franchise; do not reproduce the reference images' subjects or compositions.
reference_instruction: The attached reference images show this illustrator's hand: copy their line weight, hatching density and direction, use of solid black and white paper, and level of finish. Do not copy their subjects, compositions or framing.

cover.framing: Cinematic establishing scene with one clear focal group; open white sky in the upper third reserved for the typeset title; strong black foreground framing. Composition reads as a vignette: the drawing is densest at its focal point and thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no rectangular edge, no frame.

chapter.framing: Wide establishing scene with a low horizon, black foreground framing and a lighter, finer-lined distance. Composition reads as a vignette: the drawing is densest at its focal point and thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no rectangular edge, no frame.
chapter.note: 3:2 art at 4.5 in wide is 3.0 in tall, matching the chapter-opener art slot

world.framing: Small establishing scene that captures the section's subject. Composition reads as a vignette: the drawing is densest at its focal point and thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no rectangular edge, no frame.

climate.framing: Landscape that captures the climate's defining terrain, ruin and danger, with one or two tiny figures for scale. Composition reads as a vignette: the drawing is densest at its focal point and thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no rectangular edge, no frame.

bastion.framing: The town or fortress seen from its approach road, with its defining feature unmistakable and tiny figures for scale. Composition reads as a vignette: the drawing is densest at its focal point and thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no rectangular edge, no frame.

ancestry.framing: Single full-length adventurer of this ancestry in travel-worn gear, three-quarter view. Isolated on white paper with only a small patch of ground and its cast shadow; no background scenery.

background.framing: A small still life of the tools, garments and keepsakes of this background's trade; no figure, so it never resembles a class or ancestry portrait. Isolated on white paper; no background scenery. PHYSICAL PLAUSIBILITY (owner review 2026-10-13): every object rests on a surface, leans against a visible support, or hangs from a visible hook, strap, peg or nail, and it obeys gravity: nothing floats or juts out unsupported, cloth and rope hang downward, heavy things sit low, a balance scale tips toward its heavier pan. Each object is the true medieval European form of the thing named, drawn correctly: no modern items (fountain pens, wristwatches, zippers) and no East Asian weapons (no kunai, shuriken or ninja gear).

class.framing: Single full-length adventurer in an action-ready pose with class-typical arms and gear, three-quarter view. Isolated on white paper with only a small patch of ground and its cast shadow; no background scenery.

monster.framing: Single creature, full body, three-quarter view, in a characteristic menacing pose; a small human figure for scale only if the creature is Large or Huge. Isolated on white paper with only a small patch of ground and its cast shadow; no background scenery.

item.framing: Still-life arrangement of the described objects, worn and used. Isolated on white paper with only a small patch of ground and its cast shadow; no background scenery.

tradition.framing: Small scene vignette of the tradition's magic at work, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper toward irregular edges; no frame.

scenario.framing: The scenario's key place and threat at the moment before action, with small figures for scale. Composition reads as a vignette: the drawing is densest at its focal point and thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no rectangular edge, no frame. Show the scenario's place and situation as the parties arrive; any named creature, guardian or boss appears only small, partial, distant or in silhouette, so the image is clearly distinct from that creature's bestiary portrait.

campaign.framing: Interior or architectural view of the described stronghold room. Composition reads as a vignette: the drawing is densest at its focal point and thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no rectangular edge, no frame.

boss.framing: The unique named boss shown with its distinguishing features in its own lair or setting, dramatic in scale; clearly an individual, not a typical member of a kind. Composition reads as a vignette that thins out into white paper toward irregular edges; no frame.

hero.framing: Single full-length Hero standing alone, drawn whole from the top of the head to the soles of the feet, in a ready three-quarter pose that shows the listed ancestry, class, background and every listed item of equipment. Borderless and isolated on blank white paper with no background of any kind: only a few sparse strokes of ground and a short cast shadow directly under the feet.
hero.style: Aim halfway between the two attached versions, with a clear preference for version 1's old-school pen-and-ink character. Use lively variable-weight dip-pen contours, rough brush accents, scratchy directional hatching, local crosshatching and dry-brush shadows. Recover version 1's tactile, hand-drawn materials without its indiscriminate distress or crowded texture. Balance this with version 2's readable solid blacks, open white areas, intact clothing, distinct silhouette and clearly constructed equipment. Use medium detail density: richer and rougher than version 2, quieter than version 1. Clothing is worn but maintained, with intact hems and occasional neat repairs. Each hero has individual facial features, clothing and material choices. Keep all required equipment legible at about two inches wide. Light from upper left. Pure black ink on white, no grey wash, colour or digital polish.
hero.final: Avoid photorealism, digital-render polish, clean vector-like line, stippled or noisy texture, all-over mechanical crosshatching, painterly shading, smooth gradients, grey wash, grey or coloured tint, airbrush, typography, readable runes, watermarks, signatures, modern objects, cartoon or anime proportions, tattered or ragged cloth, stray specks, cropped limbs and anything touching the image edge. The finished artwork is pure black ink on white, bold and readable at small size, with at least 10% clean white margin on every side, and prints crisply, like original ink art in an old-school fantasy rulebook.

price_per_mtok_usd.note: Estimates from the published Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) rates; Google's billing console is authoritative.

size_words.L: Large: roughly twice a human's height or bulk
size_words.H: Huge: towering many times a human's size

prompt_v2.note: Prompt structure modelled on the owner's Greythorn prompt (2026-10-10). Sections are assembled by tools/art_generate.py prompt_for(); owner prompts in production/art/OWNER_PROMPTS.json override an entry entirely. Hand-inked direction (owner, 2026-10-11): economy of line, selective hatching, open white paper; no 'exceptionally detailed' or stippling language, which produced hyper-detailed AI-looking results. Gritty old-school direction (owner, 2026-10-11 later): bold rough brush contours, heavy solid blacks, scratchy hatching and dry-brush texture with woodcut bite, high contrast, visible human imperfection; still pure black ink, no grey wash, no stipple fields or uniform machine texture.
prompt_v2.intro: Create a gritty, old-school black-and-white ink illustration of {identity}, in the dark fantasy world of Heraldry Skirmish, drawn the way a human illustrator inked the interior art of a late-1970s or 1980s fantasy rulebook or adventure module: brush, dip pen and India ink on paper, with the bite of a woodcut.
format_scene: {aspect_words} composition. Pure black ink on warm ivory-white paper, with no colour, lettering, borders, or decorative framing.

The illustration must have a natural, irregular, hand-drawn white vignette around all four edges. The artwork gradually dissolves into blank ivory-white paper through increasingly sparse pen strokes, broken outlines and diminishing hatching.

Leave approximately 5-8% clean white margin around the perimeter, with an additional organic transition zone. Avoid digital blur, artificial feathering, or hard rectangular cropping. Keep crisp line and strong contrast at the focal point.
format_figure: {aspect_words} composition. Pure black ink on warm ivory-white paper, with no colour, lettering, borders, or decorative framing.
A single subject drawn whole, isolated on blank ivory-white paper: only a small patch of ground beneath it and its cast shadow, which fade out in a few sparse strokes. No background scenery.
Leave at least 8% clean white margin on every side; nothing touches or is cropped by the image edge. The silhouette must read clearly when printed about two inches wide.
format_still: {aspect_words} composition. Pure black ink on warm ivory-white paper, with no colour, lettering, borders, or decorative framing.
A still-life arrangement isolated on blank ivory-white paper, resting on a small surface that fades out in a few sparse strokes. No figure and no background scenery.
Leave at least 8% clean white margin on every side; nothing touches or is cropped by the image edge.
prompt_v2.style_scene: Ink it gritty and bold, like old-school rulebook art: strong brush contours of uneven weight, large shapes of solid black for shadow, night and depth, and rough, scratchy hatching and dry-brush drag where light turns into shadow, with the bite of a woodcut. High contrast: let solid black and open white paper carry the picture, with few in-between textures. Visible human marks are welcome: broken lines, dry-brush streaks, a few flicked ink spatters. Put the deepest blacks and sharpest contrast at the focal point and let distance thin to simpler, lighter line. No stipple fields, no uniform micro-texture, no tonal haze, no smooth digital rendering. Accurate perspective, believable construction and coherent geography; the world shows withered beauty: once-grand things rusted, cracked, overgrown or hollowed by age. It must look drawn by hand with brush and ink, not generated or rendered.
prompt_v2.style_figure: Ink it like gritty old-school rulebook monster and character art: a bold, rough brush contour of uneven weight, heavy solid-black shadow shapes, and scratchy hatching or dry-brush drag where form turns from light into shadow. High contrast, with few in-between textures; small human imperfections such as broken lines and dry-brush streaks are welcome. It reads as a strong silhouette first and detail second: no stippled skin, no uniform micro-texture, no over-rendered surfaces. Light falls from the upper left. Believable anatomy, armour construction, weapon grips and materials, worn, scarred and weathered. It must look drawn by hand with brush, pen and ink, not generated or rendered.
prompt_v2.final_scene: Avoid photorealism, digital-render polish, clean vector-like line, uniform machine texture, stipple fields, painterly shading, smooth gradients, grey wash or grey ink tones, airbrush, colour, typography, readable runes, watermarks, signatures, modern objects, artificial symmetry and competing focal points. The finished artwork should be gritty and high-contrast and print crisply in pure black ink, with an organically fading white vignette, like original ink art in an old-school fantasy rulebook.
prompt_v2.final_figure: Avoid photorealism, digital-render polish, clean vector-like line, stippled or noisy texture, painterly shading, smooth gradients, grey wash or grey ink tones, airbrush, colour, typography, readable runes, watermarks, signatures, modern objects, cartoon or anime proportions and cropped limbs. The finished artwork should be gritty, bold and readable at small size and print crisply in pure black ink, like original ink art in an old-school fantasy rulebook.
prompt_v2.reference: The attached reference images show the target ink style. Match their bold, rough contours, heavy solid blacks, scratchy hatching, dry-brush texture, contrast and finish. Some are centuries-old etchings or woodcuts: take only their line, blacks and finish, never their period costume. Do not copy their subjects or compositions, and draw in pure black ink only.
prompt_v2.style_still: Ink it like old-school rulebook equipment art: a bold, rough contour of uneven weight around each object, heavy solid-black shadow shapes, and scratchy hatching or dry-brush drag that follows each material: grain on wood, dents and pits on metal, folds and wear on leather and cloth. High contrast, with few in-between textures. Each object reads as a clear silhouette first and detail second: no stipple fields, no uniform micro-texture, no over-rendered surfaces. Light falls from the upper left. Believable construction, worn and used. It must look drawn by hand with brush, pen and ink, not generated or rendered.

gpt_no_references.note: Owner decision 2026-10-31: Codex's and ChatGPT Work's image tools no longer accept reference files for a new image ("Omit both referenced_image_paths and num_last_images_to_include when generating a brand new image"), so these items are generated by Codex from their prompts alone: no references in the queue and no STYLE REFERENCES section in the prompt. The prompts' style sections still carry the full ink direction; the assigned reviewer compares each delivered image against its family's reference set and sends redos for drift.
